# P31.7 (DEEPEN.3): claim re-sightings + latest-capture dating

Implements `docs/tickets/P31.7__claim-re-sightings.md` (Round 9 Wave B, manifest row 148).
Live-verified (`live_verification=true`): the sqitch change deployed hosted, the image built and
digest-pinned, 70 jobs rolled with batch-05 excluded (D-P31.4-1), a bounded sink-bench measured the
per-link cost on the real spine, and the hosted resolution materializer ran with the new basis plus a
+0 re-run. Closes **D-P30.2a-2**; leaves **D-P31.4-1**, **D-P31.5-2**, **D-P30.2a-1** OPEN.
Stacked on the P31.6 tip `devin/p31-6-access-edges-and-hosted-link-materialization`. ADR-114 is the
design's `ADR-R9-RESIGHT`.

## Summary

- **Re-sightings are recorded (uncapped — the ratified Q5 option (a)).** `PgClaimSink` hands each
  chunk's already-stored duplicates to the new production `on_duplicates` hook
  `record_resightings` **inside the chunk transaction**: one `claim_evidence` row
  (`role='establishes'`) per re-sighted claim onto the execution's own per-(source, genre, run)
  capture, via the existing `_LINK_EVIDENCE` insert (`ON CONFLICT (claim_id, capture_id, role) DO
  NOTHING`). Duplicates still insert +0 claims; the *same* capture re-flushed inserts +0 links;
  there is no cap and no digest-changed filter. `make_claim_sink('pg')` wires the hook next to
  `record_object_ref`; the asserting `replay_ingest` path builds its sink directly without it, and
  `batch.replay` short-circuits inside the hook — a replay re-reads stored bytes, so it is never a
  sighting.
- **Dating basis decided: latest capture.** The resolver's capture-time fallback for undated claims
  now reads `max(ec2.retrieved_at)` — the most recent sighting — labelled
  `capture_retrieved_at_latest` in `rules_fired` (`SIG-RECON-008:observed_at=…`). ADR-104 §4's
  interim `min(...)`/`capture_retrieved_at` basis predated re-sighting links (every claim had
  exactly one capture then, so min == max). This is what makes an A → B → A restatement resolve to
  A under `latest_observation_wins`.
- **Resolution supersession is now real.** A changed `input_digest` (a re-sighting moved the
  observation date) lands as a superseding decision: the new sqitch change
  `resolution_supersede` adds `close_superseded_resolutions(uuid[], text[], text[])` — SECURITY
  DEFINER, one batch round trip — which closes the prior **live `auto`** row's `sys_period`
  (history kept; readers filter `upper_inf(sys_period)`), reports pairs pinned by a live non-auto
  decision as `blocked`, and is executable only by `sig_materialize`, which keeps its INSERT-only
  posture (no UPDATE/DELETE grant on `resolution`). The materializer counts `superseded` and
  `skipped_pinned`; `read_materialized_resolutions` returns only current rows.
- **Append-only held.** `n_tup_upd`/`n_tup_del` = 0 on `claim`, `claim_evidence`, `resolution`
  after the hosted run; the only temporal write is the sanctioned sys_period closure.
- **Storage is measured, not assumed (Q5's condition).** 210.9 B per link (table + indexes,
  amortised) measured on the real spine; 12-month projection ~6.4 GB against the live-read 15 GB
  disk (43% — under the 50% ADR-114 trigger) and 64% of the operator's 10 GB comparison (crosses
  ~month 9–10). The trigger + the 10 GB flag are written into ADR-114's revisit section.

## Hosted run record

- Schema (`materialize.sh --apply schema`, sqitch over cloud-sql-proxy): `+ partner_org_identity_key`
  (owed since P31.5) + `+ resolution_supersede`, both verified.
- Images (Cloud Build from `git archive HEAD`, digest-pinned, `:latest` unmoved):
  ingest `sig-api:p31-7-062306e70d3d` → `sha256:6ad5477d4aac…f5`;
  materializer `sig-api:materialize-062306e70d3d` → `sha256:959c40c607…d5`.
- Roll: `sig-ops roll-jobs --apply --exclude sig-ingest-camreg-batch-05` — 70 planned → 70 applied →
  70 verified on `6ad5477d…`; batch-05 confirmed still on `feff986c…` (D-P31.4-1).
- Bounded measurement (`sig-sink-bench-pxgq9`, `camreg_fl511_fl`, 2 passes):
  pass 1: 128,383 considered → +12,335 claims, 103,713 duplicates, +116,048 links;
  pass 2: +0 claims, 116,048 duplicates → +116,048 links.
  `claim_evidence` 2,391,551 → 2,623,647; relation 357.8 → 406.7 MB; DB 4.78 → 4.83 GB.
- Resolution materialization (`sig-materialize`, role `sig_materialize`): first run
  `sig-materialize-bnq5m` (65 min) — 1,965,997 pairs considered, **203,786** new decision rows,
  1,732,911 unchanged, 29,300 unresolvable, **139,433** live auto decisions superseded,
  **0** pinned; zero duplicate live pairs. First re-run `sig-materialize-9jlgv` died on a Cloud SQL
  connection reset mid-transaction (rollback verified — counts unchanged); second re-run
  `sig-materialize-mdfpm` (exit 0, ~2 h) is a clean **+0**: `inserted`/`superseded`/
  `skipped_pinned` = 0, `skipped_existing` 1,936,697 = every live row.
- Disk: `dataDiskSizeGb` read live = 15 GB PD-SSD (autoresize on). DB 5.19 GB post-materialization
  ≈ 35% of 15 GB.
